summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its ongoing share buy-back program announced on 5 August 2026. On 25 August 2026, HSBC repurchased 200,000 ordinary shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of £15.0886 and 325,600 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at an average of HK$163.2150. The purchases were executed by BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC, with shares bought for cancellation, reducing issued capital. Since commencement, HSBC has repurchased 19,252,614 shares for approximately US$396.8 million. Watch for continued buy-back execution and effects on earnings per share.
